name: QUIDTECH-CAPE
description: This study develops and implements QUIDTECH-CAPE, a developmental research framework that integrates the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality model with the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Tested among 40 BSIT students and validated by 5 IT experts at Our Lady of the Sacred Heart College of Guimba, Inc., the framework establishes a standardized, 7-construct matrix to evaluate undergraduate capstone computing projects objectively while balancing technical software metrics with behavioral user-acceptance criteria.
